properties.english_form: A device must obtain a network session context before sending application data.

must_have_properties: Chirp Spread Spectrum (CSS) modulation with Spreading Factor SF7-SF12.
Channel bandwidth 125 / 250 / 500 kHz and coding rate 4/5..4/8.
Frame = preamble + sync word (0x34 public / 0x12 private) + optional header + payload + 16-bit CRC.
LoRaWAN star-of-stars with end-devices, gateways, and a network server.
Class A mandatory (RX1/RX2 windows); Class B/C optional supersets.
OTAA and/or ABP activation with the DevEUI/JoinEUI/AppKey -> DevAddr/NwkSKey/AppSKey key hierarchy.
Adaptive Data Rate and the standard MAC-command set.
AES-128 4-byte MIC integrity + AES-128 payload encryption + FCnt replay protection.
must_not_have_properties: GAP/GATT or BLE advertising/connection events (that is Bluetooth Low Energy, not LoRa).
13.56 MHz inductive coupling / ISO 14443 / NDEF (that is NFC).
DSSS / O-QPSK / IEEE 802.15.4 / PAN-ID / ZCL (that is Zigbee).
A frame counter that does not increase (replay-vulnerable).

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Device uses 0x12 on a public 0x34 network (or vice versa) and detects no frames.
Counter not greater than last accepted; frame rejected.
Device exceeds the regional airtime budget.
RX1/RX2 opened at the wrong delay; downlink lost.
Join-Accept not received in the join window; OTAA retried.

fields.lora_distinguishers: LoRa/LoRaWAN is identified by ALL of: Chirp Spread Spectrum (CSS) modulation with a Spreading Factor SF7-SF12; a 125/250/500 kHz bandwidth and a 4/5..4/8 coding rate; a preamble + sync word + header + payload + CRC frame; sub-GHz LPWAN operation with a ~154 dB link budget; the LoRaWAN star-of-stars of end-devices, gateways, and a network server; device Classes A/B/C; OTAA/ABP activation with DevEUI/JoinEUI/AppKey -> DevAddr/NwkSKey/AppSKey; Adaptive Data Rate; duty-cycle ALOHA; RX1/RX2 receive windows; and an AES-128 4-byte MIC plus payload encryption. This is distinct from BLE (GAP/GATT, advertising, 2.4 GHz / 40 channels), NFC (13.56 MHz inductive coupling, ISO 14443/NDEF), and Zigbee (DSSS/O-QPSK, IEEE 802.15.4, PAN-ID, ZCL) — none of which use CSS, a spreading factor, or the LoRaWAN MAC.
